description:
## Because

- The `WebAuthnHelpersExample` page is a 1,298-line developer harness that only a Storybook story mounts. No route, test, or other module uses it.
- The passkey owners agreed to remove it.

## This pull request

- Removes `pages/WebAuthnHelpersExample/index.tsx`, `index.stories.tsx` and `fieldGuides.tsx` from `fxa-settings`.
- Keeps `lib/passkeys/webauthn.ts` and `lib/base64url.ts` unchanged. Product code still uses all the exports that the page imported.
